title: AI Governance & Regulation: Frontier Watch Deep Research Plan
report_path: report/2026/11/2026-11-16-ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准.md

new_findings.key: 欧盟人工智能法案ai-act对内部部署internal-deployment的适用范围存在解释争议直接影响企业合规边界
new_findings.text: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）对“内部部署”（internal deployment）的适用范围存在解释争议，直接影响企业合规边界
new_findings.evidence: 论文分析了 AI Act 第 2(1)、2(6)、2(8) 条，梳理了将内部部署纳入/排除监管范围的多种解释路径，供欧盟委员会、提供者、部署方及法院参考

new_findings.key: openai-的公开话语体系中安全风险对齐等伦理概念的使用随时间显著演变反映行业自我治理叙事的战略性调整
new_findings.text: OpenAI 的公开话语体系中，“安全”“风险”“对齐”等伦理概念的使用随时间显著演变，反映行业自我治理叙事的战略性调整
new_findings.evidence: 通过结构化语料库（区分大众传播与学术传播）及 NLP 主题建模，量化了 OpenAI 伦理修辞的时序变化，揭示其框架策略的动态特征

new_findings.key: ai-采用正在重塑招聘需求职位发布中的工作活动频次与内容随-ai-暴露度基于-copilotclaude-使用数据系统性变化
new_findings.text: AI 采用正在重塑招聘需求：职位发布中的工作活动频次与内容随 AI 暴露度（基于 Copilot/Claude 使用数据）系统性变化
new_findings.evidence: 构建活动级 AI 暴露度指标，发现高暴露活动在招聘中占比下降，低暴露活动上升，暗示劳动力市场与技能政策需同步调整

new_findings.key: 公众对-ai-预测权威的感知会改变决策推理导致-40-以上参与者放弃确定收益暗示-ai-系统在高风险决策中需受更严监管
new_findings.text: 公众对 AI 预测权威的感知会改变决策推理，导致 40% 以上参与者放弃确定收益，暗示 AI 系统在高风险决策中需受更严监管
new_findings.evidence: 基于 1,305 名参与者的 Newcomb 悖论行为实验，感知到的 AI 预测权威使放弃确定奖励的几率上升 3.39 倍（95% CI: 2.45-4.70），收益减少 10.7-42.9%，即使预测反复失效效应仍存

new_findings.text: AI adoption in industry is accelerating, with explicit AI mentions in job postings increasing 66% from 2023-2025 across 33 firms.
new_findings.evidence: Analysis of 50,000 job advertisements from 33 firms between 2023-2025 shows explicit mentions of AI increased by 66%, though much growth occurs outside actual work activity descriptions.

new_findings.text: AI incident governance lacks standardized definitions, taxonomies, monitoring practices, and reporting mechanisms, representing a gap in technical standards for deployed AI systems.
new_findings.evidence: Paper examines existing frameworks for AI incident governance and identifies open problems in definitions, taxonomies, monitoring, reporting, and incident analysis.

new_findings.text: Ethical AI discourse varies significantly across stakeholders (e.g., OpenAI), indicating fragmented standards landscape and competing visions for responsible AI development.
new_findings.evidence: Case study of OpenAI analyzes how 'ethics', 'safety', 'alignment' concepts are leveraged in public discourse over time, revealing distinct framings across actors.

new_findings.text: Perceived predictive authority of AI can alter human decision-making reasoning, suggesting need for standards on AI-human interaction transparency in deployed systems.
new_findings.evidence: Behavioral study (N=1,305) shows over 40% participants treated AI as predictive authority, increasing odds of forgoing guaranteed reward by 3.39x and reducing earnings 10.7-42.9%, persisting even when predictions failed.
